about_short_description.short_description: Jeeves is a consumer service company that provides repair and maintenance solutions for home appliances.

product.name: Repair & Refurbish
product.description: Jeeves offers repair and refurbishment services for home appliances, electronics, mobiles, and furniture, covering both in-warranty and out-of-warranty products.

product.name: Installation & Demo
product.description: Jeeves provides installation and demonstration services for home appliances and electronics, ensuring products are set up and ready for use.

product.name: Extended Warranties
product.description: Jeeves offers extended warranty plans that provide additional coverage for products beyond the standard warranty period.

product.name: Annual Maintenance Contracts
product.description: Jeeves provides annual maintenance contracts for continued protection and servicing of products that are out of warranty.

product.name: Spare Parts Management
product.description: Jeeves manages spare parts supply, ensuring availability and timely delivery across India through a network of warehouses.

product.name: Customer Relations
product.description: Jeeves offers customer support through multiple channels, including call centers, to handle inquiries and service requests.
